DbUnavailable.description: db_unavailable: the database could not serve this request right now because of its availability or of contention (a lock not granted in time, a deadlock, no connection to be had, a connection that was lost). It says nothing about the database and gives no retry hint: no Retry-After header and no extra fields. Any operation that reads or writes the database can answer it; try the request again later. It is not the answer to a request that failed for another reason (those stay 4xx or an internal error).

isScheduleMilestone.description: A schedule node of duration 0. It is not a Project Milestone.

day.description: The day in the Sprint's zone that this point closes; null for the point at the start

get.summary: Server features and configured limits. `features` also names what depends on the configuration: `mcp` (the MCP gateway), `email` (the server sends e-mail: invitations are mailed too) and `password-reset` (password reset by e-mail, which needs e-mail).

Revoke the session cookie

Ask for a password reset mail. Only while the server sends e-mail (feature `password-reset` in /v1/server-info; 404 otherwise). Every well-formed request is answered the same way (202, no body) and as fast, whether or not the address has an account, the account is disabled, or it only signs in through a provider: the request is counted and the rest runs in the background. A mail is sent only to an enabled account with a password. The link in it (`/reset-password#<token>`) works once and for 30 minutes, and a newer request replaces it. Counted per address, per account and per account-and-address with the sign-in limits (`PENFII_LOGIN_THROTTLE_*`), on counters of their own; a full counter answers the same 202 and sends nothing.

400.description: validation (the address is not an e-mail address)

post.summary: Set a new password with the token of a reset link. The password follows the usual rule (15 to 128 characters, not a known weak one); a password that breaks it is refused with 400 and the link stays usable. On success every session of the account ends, and the person signs in again; nothing signs them in. A token that is unknown, used, replaced or expired, or whose account is disabled, is refused the same way (409 reset_token_invalid).

400.description: validation (the password does not meet the rule)

Serves protocol 2026-07-28 (per-request _meta, MCP-Protocol-Version / Mcp-Method / Mcp-Name headers, server/discover) and the 2025-11-25 era (initialize, ping) from one operation catalog. No cookie, no CSRF header. Origin and Host are checked. 401 carries WWW-Authenticate with resource_metadata; a missing scope is 403 insufficient_scope. Only while MCP is enabled (PENFII_MCP_ENABLED).
